items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Reverend Thomas Jefferson Fields was my father and Mary Jane Garrett Fields, mother.

ctx.x: I was born in Nacogdoches, Texas, Sunday at midnight, August 28, 1904. Reverend Thomas Jefferson Fields was my father and Mary Jane Garrett Fields, mother. The baby of the family of three boys and two girls. The family moved to an all black town, Taft, Oklahoma, 1905. At that time, indian territory.
My father was killed accidentally in 1906. I was known as Sonny Boy before school age and until the fifth grade while going to school.
